purpose: Pure shake detector reused in desktop UI simulation; no hardware scripts or device access.

adapter.api: preview::SyntheticMotionAdapter::shake() -> bool; optional constructor uint32 initial virtual milliseconds defaults to zero
adapter.persistent_state: One copied ShakeDetector and uint32 virtual millisecond clock per adapter instance
adapter.success: true only if exactly one detector event occurs across the complete fixture

adapter_checks: 100 sequential requests retain detector and virtual clock and each return exactly one event
100 requests from uint32 max-1000 cross unsigned clock wrap and each return exactly one event
